title: Adventure Activities in Rishikesh - Rafting, Bungee, Trekking & More
content:
Adventure Activities in Rishikesh,

Rishikesh is not just a spiritual hub but also the adventure capital of India. Nestled in the foothills of the Himalayas and blessed with the mighty Ganga River, it offers a perfect mix of nature, thrill, and adrenaline-pumping experiences.

From the world-famous white-water rafting to India’s highest bungee jumping point, Rishikesh is a paradise for adventure seekers. Whether you’re a beginner or an expert, the town has something exciting for everyone -rafting rapids, camping under the stars, zip-lining across the Ganga, or trekking through lush Himalayan trails.

Here are the top adventure activities in Rishikesh that make it a must-visit destination for thrill lovers.

Top Adventure Activities in Rishikesh:

1-White-Water Rafting:

  • Best Experience: Ride through thrilling rapids of the Ganga.
  • Popular Stretches: Brahmapuri (9 km), Shivpuri (16 km), Marine Drive (24 km), Kaudiyala (36 km).
  • Cost: ₹500–₹2,000 (depends on stretch).

2-Bungee Jumping:

  • Location: Mohan Chatti (Jumpin Heights).
  • Height: 83 meters (India’s highest).
  • Cost: Around ₹3,500-₹4,000.

3-Zip-Lining (Flying Fox):

  • Location: Near Shivpuri & Mohan Chatti.
  • Experience: Glide over the Ganga at speeds up to 140 km/h.
  • Cost: ₹1,500–₹3,000.

4-Trekking & Camping:

  • Popular Treks: Kunjapuri Temple trek, Neer Garh Waterfall trek, Himalayan jungle trails.
  • Camping: Riverside camping with bonfires, stargazing & yoga retreats.
  • Cost: ₹1,000-₹3,000 per person per night.

5-Other Thrilling Activities:

  • Cliff Jumping - Jump from 20-40 ft cliffs into the Ganga.
  • Kayaking - Paddle through calm & rapid waters.
  • Rock Climbing & Rappelling - Try Himalayan cliffside adventures.
  • Paragliding (nearby Tehri Lake) - Fly over stunning landscapes.

Best Time to Visit Rishikesh for Adventure Activities:

  • Peak Season (October - March): Cool and pleasant weather with temperatures 10°C - 25°C. Best time for rafting, bungee, trekking, and camping.
  • Moderate Season (April - June): Warm temperatures 20°C - 35°C. Perfect for water-based activities like rafting, kayaking, and cliff jumping.
  • Low Season (July - September): Monsoon season with temperatures 18°C - 30°C. Most adventure sports like rafting & bungee remain closed due to safety, but trekking in lush green trails is still possible.

How to Reach Rishikesh for Adventure Activities:

  • By Road: Well connected to Delhi (approx. 240 km) and Dehradun (45 km).
  • By Train: Rishikesh railway station, or Haridwar (25 km away).
  • By Air: Jolly Grant Airport, Dehradun (21 km away).

Best Places to Visit Near Adventure Spots (within 50 km):

1- Triveni Ghat (3 km): Evening Ganga Aarti.

2- Ram Jhula (4 km): Suspension bridge & temples.

3- Laxman Jhula (6 km): Iconic hanging bridge.

4- Parmarth Niketan Ashram (4.5 km): Yoga & spirituality.

5- Beatles Ashram (5 km): Meditation domes & wall art.

6- Neer Garh Waterfall (6 km): Trekking & natural pools.

7- Neelkanth Mahadev Temple (30 km): Mythological Shiva temple.

5- Rajaji National Park  (20 km - Chilla Gate): Wildlife safaris.

9- Kunjapuri Temple (28 km): Sunrise trek viewpoint.

10- Har Ki Pauri, Haridwar (30 km): Sacred ghat for evening Aarti.
excerpt: Rishikesh, the adventure capital of India, offers thrilling activities like white-water rafting, bungee jumping, zip-lining, trekking, and camping. With its mix of adrenaline and natural beauty, it is the ultimate destination for both adventure seekers and nature lovers.
